query: I was out walking my golden retriever this morning and he ended up chasing a squirrel right into a patch of dandelions, I spent half an hour brushing seeds out of his fur when I got back home. I also just tried the new matcha latte at the café down the street, it was way too sweet even when I asked for less sugar, I probably won’t order it again. Oh and I finally got around to rearranging the bookshelf in my living room, I sorted all my fiction books by color and it looks so much nicer now. Anyway, I’m having some issues with my phone right now—airplane mode is turned on, my network preference is acting up and giving me bad connections, my data mode is off, and data saver mode is enabled, and I can’t get anything that needs internet to work properly, can you help me fix this?
